title: MedicalRSI: Medical Recursive Self-Improving Agents via Clinical Model-Harness Co-Evolution
abstract: arXiv:2611.26806v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Medical agents built on large language models (LLMs) have advanced rapidly, yet most stay fixed once deployed and do not keep using their experience to improve later attempts. As a result, the same kind of error can recur across patients. To address this, existing self-improvement methods update an agent's weights or its medical harness from its own experience, but their improving strategy stays fixed and never learns which changes actually help, which caps how much the agent can improve. Recursive self-improvement (RSI) instead improves both the agent and its improving strategy. However, achieving RSI for medical agents is challenging, because clinical workflows rarely come with a reference harness, and a change that fixes early errors may not fix the problems the agent meets later. We propose MedicalRSI, an RSI framework built on Clinical Model-Harness Co-Evolution, in which one model plays two roles. The Solver is the medical agent

translated_title: MedicalRSI：通过临床模型-框架协同进化实现医疗递归自我改进智能体
translated_abstract: 基于大语言模型（LLM）构建的医疗智能体发展迅速，但大多数智能体在部署后便保持固定，不会持续利用自身经验来改进后续的尝试。因此，同类错误可能会在不同患者身上反复出现。为解决这一问题，现有的自我改进方法会基于智能体自身的经验来更新其权重或医疗框架，但其改进策略本身保持固定，从不学习哪些改变真正有效，这限制了智能体可提升的上限。递归自我改进（RSI）则同时改进智能体本身及其改进策略。然而，为医疗智能体实现RSI具有挑战性，因为临床工作流程很少配有参考框架，且某个能修复早期错误的改变未必能修复智能体后续遇到的问题。我们提出了MedicalRSI，一个建立在临床模型-框架协同进化之上的RSI框架，其中一个模型扮演两个角色。Solver（求解器）是医疗智能体……
tldr: 该论文提出MedicalRSI框架，通过临床模型-框架协同进化使医疗智能体能够同时改进自身及其改进策略，从而实现递归自我改进，避免同类错误在不同患者间反复出现。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes MedicalRSI, a recursive self-improvement framework built on Clinical Model-Harness Co-Evolution, enabling medical agents to improve both themselves and their improvement strategies, thereby preventing the same errors from recurring across patients.
